horoscope: With today's Full Moon, there can be the illumination of a matter, an epiphany, or a culmination, dear Aries. This lunation occurs in your communications and immediate environment sector, stirring up flux and activity, largely on a mental level. You may have errands to run, deadlines to meet, a project or study coming to a close, or news of travel or an educational matter. This lunation may bring a project to a head or an important realization into your consciousness. Do what you can to avoid feeling overwhelmed. What emerges from all of this in the coming days can lead to important ideas, particularly related to learning, teaching, publishing, and career. Today, you can feel stronger as you establish your independence, but it’s also a good time to explore your desire to connect with like-minded people or with a special plan.

Today's Full Moon in your resources sector can bring light to a financial matter, dear Taurus, or to issues surrounding personal possessions, valuables, talents, and resources. A turning point can arise in a close relationship, with money, or in business, and a revelation may lead to new and important ideas in the coming days. For some, a situation may require you to defend or stand up for yourself. A wake-up call surrounding managing your money and personal resources may be part of the picture now. This lunation falls along an axis that also has to do with talents and resources, as well as sexual and intimate relationships, so new feelings or discoveries may revolve around these things. It's a significant time of year to balance the give-and-take in a relationship or the giving and receiving of pleasure. Try not to get too excited until all the facts are in, but pay close attention to what your emotions and intuition are telling you now. You can also be seeking something heady or absorbing, and you gravitate to the right project or pursuit. You have more conviction about your insights or ideas.

The Full Moon occurs in your sign today, dear Gemini, pulling up mighty, powerful, and previously buried or unacknowledged emotions. This can be a time of release, epiphany, or culmination. Pay attention to your feelings but take your time forming conclusions and decisions. If you're thinking about making significant changes, sit with this decision a while longer to see what sticks. For now, your feelings are in the spotlight. There can be a revelation or epiphany about a partnership or about your image, independence, and ability to take charge of your life. If you've been focusing a lot on others and ignoring your needs in the process, you can experience a burst of independence and self-interest now. Make changes later based on the personal revelations you have now. Fortunately, you’re building stronger bonds and enjoying contributing right now. Your perspective is shifting in powerful, positive ways, and you're more interested in sharing your ideas and causes with others.

The Full Moon today brings strong emotions to the surface, dear Cancer, as well as awareness of feelings you've been burying. It lights up your privacy sector, an area of your chart much like a closet, and it isn't used to a show of lights. What you see now can be surprising, but it can also lead the way to important changes. Letting go of the past in significant ways is important now. It's a process, and not a quick one, but you are making revelations that really take you far. If you've been working too hard or focusing so much on practical matters recently, as many Cancers have, this is a time when the need to face your emotions or get extra rest becomes clear. Seek balance! For the best results, listen to your intuition, but wait to draw conclusions and make big decisions. Also today, you might develop strategies, make plans, and dig deeply into a matter to find out a whole lot more about it. Financial backing or moral support is more forthcoming for your longer-term goals or career.

Today's Full Moon can stir a discovery or epiphany in your social life, dear Leo. A friendship or romance can reach a turning point, or there could be a sudden need to detach yourself from personal focus in order to connect with others in meaningful ways. You are reminded of the role you play in others' lives or even in your community. This can be a time to make an announcement, to perform a humanitarian gesture, or to reach out to people around you after a relatively self-absorbed period. Seek balance now. Take in information, but take your time to process everything. Today is, in fact, strong for gaining new insights into special people in your life. Rewarding experiences can positively impact a relationship or can even bring a new connection into your life. Tackling a pleasantly challenging topic or project can be satisfying.

The Moon is Full today, dear Virgo, and can bring you into the spotlight or increase your visibility, as it occurs at the top of your solar chart. Pay closer attention to the rules now, and the Full Moon's energy can remind you to manage your time and attention more effectively. This means keeping your personal and professional or public lives separate, and not letting either one be neglected or overdone. Something comes to light now, likely revolving around your career, reputation, or responsibilities. A sudden job opportunity, or some form of assistance with regard to career, home, or property matters, could be part of the picture. The Full Moon today brings a reputation, career, or responsibility matter to light. You might suddenly be in the position to perform, take charge, or otherwise lead and manage. Also today, you have support from work, or your work is pleasantly involving. You gravitate to absorbing or soulful activities, and pursuing work or health goals can be especially satisfying. A personal revelation can spur you into motion, and you’re now ready to tackle a project or take on a new initiative.

With a Full Moon occurring in your solar ninth house today, dear Libra, you are reminded of your need for increased freedom, spontaneity, and fresh experiences. You may be publishing or completing a major project, or simply realizing you need more adventure in your life. Departing from your usual routine or way of thinking in a significant way could be part of the picture. This Full Moon can bring illumination to, or the culmination of, learning matters or projects. An idea that you've been working on might blossom now. Also today, you may feel gently motivated to improve your life, and you might benefit from shared activities. It can be a time to explore more satisfying ways to express yourself uniquely or creatively.

Today's Full Moon occurs in your intimacy sector, dear Scorpio, and may bring matters to fruition or illuminate issues, likely related to finances, shared resources, and personal power. While there could be some drama with regard to money, it might be a time for settling debts or collecting money owed. There can be new insight into a relationship or into a personal matter. You might experience a moment of truth that motivates you to kick a bad habit and live a freer, more joyful life as a result. Emotions are the star of the day and important now but can cloud over logic, so feel and honor them but take your time before making significant decisions. You might also feel quite motivated to work hard to boost your family income or comfort now. You might enjoy a renewed commitment to living well at home and in your daily routines.

Today's Full Moon occurs in your opposite sign and partnership sector, dear Sagittarius. This can bring relationship matters to light, or it might point to an important epiphany or turning point. Full Moons can bring sudden awareness of a pre-existing situation you've overlooked or left unacknowledged, but they can also bring new information that's a game changer. With the Sun in your sign, personal interests are in focus, and this is helpful and necessary. However, if you've neglected relationship needs, then you're likely to recognize them now. This can test a partnership but also offer an opportunity to connect more fully with your feelings and/or a special someone. With today’s transits, you could get the chance (and confidence) to dive deeply into a creative or exciting project.

Emotions get top billing with a Full Moon occurring today, dear Capricorn. For you, this can bring a service-related, work, health, or private matter to light. This might reveal problems or flaws in a project, but for most, it signals a new development, the fruition of a project, or a turning point that stirs up activity. It's a wakeup call, of sorts. Events might occur that push or prod you to make a lifestyle change. You've been spending more time than usual on taking care of your mental and emotional health so that you may have let some of your daily affairs and routines slide, and this is a time for recognizing the imbalance and then doing something about it. Also today, you are particularly insightful about your money situation. A practical improvement or item that makes your life better can be satisfying now.

Today's Full Moon is in your creativity and romance sector, dear Aquarius, and it's bringing light to issues around friends, romance, and personal goals. There can be an epiphany, a significant turning point, or a final word on a matter. Listen to your heart, as you're likely to discover your feelings about someone or about a pet project. This Full Moon encourages you to recognize and embrace romantic or creative feelings, and to share your good humor with others. This is about following your heart, but first and foremost, it's about knowing what's in your heart. Feelings that you've brushed aside or left unacknowledged can come rushing to the surface now. If you are in need of a nudge to get going on something creative, playful, or just-for-fun, this is the time. Also today, you tend to take the lead with your ideas and plans. Fortunately, your personality comes through beautifully in whatever personal interest or project you’re currently involved in.

Today's Full Moon can stir a sudden need to shuffle around your priorities, dear Pisces, as your attention turns to your home front and inner, personal plans. Emotions surface, bringing light to feelings and situations that were previously hidden. The need to strike a balance between your career and family life (or your professional and personal life) becomes evident with the events of the day and this week. These areas of life are stirred up for good reason, and the reason will likely become clear in the coming week. Today's Full Moon turns your attention back to home and family after spending some time attending to outside responsibilities. Any imbalances between work and family, or personal/public life, become glaringly obvious, and now is the time to take steps to balance out the scales. Also today, you could be itching to get to the truth or heart of a matter, and you can do well to make plans or devise strategies. With money, talents, and valuables, you may find yourself better positioned to manage or work toward your goals.
